name: qtum.avado.dnp.dappnode.eth
title: Qtum node
description: This is the Qtum Mainnet node. Qtum is an open sourced public blockchain platform, leveraging the security of UTXO while enabling EVM. Qtum is PoS based and boasts a Decentralized Governance Protocol (DGP) allowing specific blockchain settings to be modified by making use of smart contracts. The Qtum Web Wallet (advanced) is at https://qtum.my.ava.do:8443 (until version 0.0.14 it was at https://qtum.my.ava.do, which now opens the setup wizard).
author: AVADO
